headline.purpose: Section heads set in the display voice.

title.purpose: Product names on plates and index rows.

label.purpose: Uppercase 12px label in spec rows only.

numeral.purpose: Geist Mono tabular: catalogue numbers, prices, stock, ratings, totals.

motion.name: ease-out-expo

components.css: .ds-plate { max-width: 420px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #131413); } .ds-photo { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; background: var(--sunken, #d9dbd7); } .ds-caption { padding: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink, #131413); } .ds-caption-lead { background: var(--accent, #f2c200); color: var(--accent-ink, #131413); } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; } .ds-row-end { justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-name { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-num { font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-stock { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-add { padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--ink, #131413); color: var(--bg, #e7e8e6); border: 0; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-add:hover { background: var(--bg, #e7e8e6); color: var(--ink, #131413); } .ds-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #131413); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Premium is set as a 1960s-70s Braun and Rams product catalogue: grey offset-printed stock, near-black ink, and one signal yellow. The whole range is meant to read as one sheet, so "curated and small" is visible rather than claimed. Every product is a numbered plate with a ruled caption and a mono spec line; pages sit on a rigid 12-column grid and refuse the centered hero over an identical card grid.

The system is flat and typographic. Structure comes from hairline ink rules, ruled rows and scale contrast between a heavy tight grotesk and a monospaced data voice. There are no shadows, no gradients and no rounded softness: every corner is 2px. Yellow is a printed field, never a glow. Green and red are not brand colors; they exist only to state stock and order status.

Light and dark themes both exist (CSS variables, data-theme override on the root, otherwise the OS preference). The dark theme is the same sheet printed on black stock; yellow and the 2px shape lock do not change.
keyCharacteristics: Grey stock, near-black ink, one signal yellow used as flat fields.
Heavy tight Hanken Grotesk for voice, Geist Mono for every numeral and datum.
Numbered plates: a product's catalogue number is its rank among active products, shared by every page that shows it.
Hairline rules and spec rows instead of cards, borders-with-shadow or panels.
2px corners everywhere that is not a circle; zero shadows; zero gradients.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Yellow is a filled rectangle with Ink text on it, or a hover fill. It is never a text color on grey, a border, a gradient, a glow or a thin accent line.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: Solid yellow buttons (button-accent) mark the single primary action of a page (the product page's Add). Everywhere else the default button is Ink-filled or the Ink-outline quiet button; active and selected states are Ink-filled (the saved-wishlist heart is the one yellow state in the build).

rules.name: The Status Only Rule
rules.body: Green, umber and red state facts about stock and orders. They are never decoration, never category colors.

rules.name: The Mono Facts Rule
rules.body: Anything a shopper might compare or add up (number, price, stock, rating, quantity, total) is set in .num. Prose is never mono.

rules.name: The Heavy Voice Rule
rules.body: Headlines are weight 800 with negative tracking; there is no light or regular display weight.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate things with a rule or a field change. No box-shadow, drop-shadow or gradient exists anywhere in the build.

rules.name: The Shape Lock Rule
rules.body: 2px or square, nothing in between and nothing rounder. Do not introduce pill shapes or large radii.

dos: Do show the catalogue number (zero-padded, mono) wherever a product appears, drawn from useCatalogueNumbers so it is identical on every page.
Do use Ink 1px rules to open a block, and Hairline for separators within a list.
Do set prices, stock, ratings and counts in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
Do use btn-quiet as the default Add button, btn-ink for navigation and submit, btn-accent only for a page's single primary action.
Do keep text on yellow in Ink (#131413) in both themes.
Do keep the 2px shape lock and the 2px Ink focus outline.
Do let admin follow the same tokens with scanability first: ruled rows, mono data, status colours for stock and order state.
donts: Don't use yellow as text, border, underline or gradient on a grey ground; it is a fill only.
Don't use green, umber or red for anything but stock and order status or form errors.
Don't add shadows, gradients, blur, pills or radii above 2px.
Don't replace the 12-column plate sheet with a centered hero over an identical card grid.
Don't set prose or headlines in the mono voice, or numerals in the grotesk.
Don't invent testimonials, press or sales figures as proof; real price, live stock and real rating are the proof.
